gates.label: One capture per run, replayed by every profile
gates.requirement: Within each captured run, all compared profiles use the identical PCM, decoded trace, frame count, renderer, model, and target schedule.

gates.label: Baseline replay is event-for-event identical
gates.requirement: Every baseline-v1 row reproduces its capture-time replay exactly.

gates.label: No distinguishable false advance on the isolated corpus
gates.requirement: Dedicated distinguishable-wrong, extra-note, and omitted-bass fixtures never advance. Ambiguous harmonic cases are reported separately and never hide one.

gates.label: Dedicated safety families stay at zero at every speed
gates.requirement: False, skipped, duplicate, and incomplete-carried-bass counts remain zero at every speed under both renderers. Fresh bass remains required.

gates.label: No new unsafe advance in an ordinary passage
gates.requirement: No candidate adds a false, skipped, or duplicate advance to any sequence row relative to baseline-v1 on the identical trace, including the scored passages that belong to no dedicated safety family.

gates.label: No new unsafe advance in a dynamics or articulation run
gates.requirement: No candidate adds a false, skipped, or duplicate advance to any dynamics or articulation run relative to baseline-v1 on the identical trace.

gates.label: The diagnosed regressions do not worsen
gates.requirement: The Tone plus Salamander v05 case keeps zero false, skipped, and duplicate advances and stays a late-advance recovery; the Tone 333 ms false case does not worsen.

gates.label: Isolated correct advancement holds its fixed floor
gates.requirement: Direct remains at least 104/106 overall; Tone reaches at least 101/106.

gates.label: Course Clear advancement holds its fixed floor
gates.requirement: Both renderers remain at least 52/54 on the Course Clear fixtures.

gates.label: P95 onset-to-advance latency stays inside its limit
gates.requirement: P95 remains below 400 ms for each renderer and does not materially regress from its paired baseline.

gates.label: Held-back renderer and piano recognition is preserved
gates.requirement: Each renderer and piano aggregate over confirmation rows preserves or improves independent recognition.

gates.label: No held-back layer loses more than one independent event
gates.requirement: No individual confirmation layer, mixed run, or articulation loses more than one independent event without an explicit reviewed explanation.

gates.label: Independent recognition does not fall at any speed
gates.requirement: Independent recognition does not decrease at any speed under either renderer.

gates.label: Ordered advances and complete passages hold per renderer
gates.requirement: Ordered advances and complete passages improve or remain equal under each renderer separately; a Direct gain cannot hide a Tone regression.

gates.label: An improvement spans more than one sequence family
gates.requirement: Improvement, netted per family across both renderers, is present in more than one sequence family, and at least one family whose ordered advances rose also recognized more events independently, so the gain is not cascade amplification following one recovered early event.

gates.label: Continuous latency stays within existing limits
gates.requirement: The p95 ordered-advance latency does not materially regress from its paired baseline under either renderer.
